protocol: Seven sequential interleaved baseline/B1/B2 triples per case. Reverse the triple on even repetitions and rotate the starting variant. One warmup then one measured unprofiled call per fresh process. No overlapping batches. B1-to-B2 comparison is required in addition to baseline comparisons.
constructors: Preserved A1/B1 synthetic/public-fixture constructors in cloned scripts/workload.py. Shapes are not reduced.
additional_import_scope: Seven interleaved triples of fresh-process first-party import probes after a separate retained warmup triple. No in-process import-cache throughput claim.
numeric_acceptance: Exact all outputs/errors/state except only the diagnostics Spearman vector within absolute 1e-12; exact Pearson, axes, dtype and NaN masks. No existing test tolerance weakened.
normalization: Every raw result retained. Normalize explicit filesystem locators plus verified campaign timestamps and their derived hashes. Preserve all manifest content and state.
measurement_boundary: Imports/setup outside workload timing, identical to A1/B1 constructors. Generated backtest/features inputs and report/log writes included in execute; generated label/IC source panels outside execute on all sides. Ledger setup/commit/reopen and table snapshots included on all sides. Campaign authorization helper/run/raw-state read included on all sides.
resources: Separate baseline/B1/B2 cProfile and tracemalloc runs for campaign_504x100, backtest_504x100, features_1260x500, labels_1260x100, diagnostics_504x100_sparse, ledger_b_1000 and registry_30; never used as throughput samples. All ordinary child RSS/CPU data retained.
limits: Single-host synthetic/public-fixture feasibility. Small adverse samples remain visible; no sum of single-direction speedups, private-data claim or release/Linux readiness. Mode measure executes exactly one warmup and one sample, asserted by the triple driver.
